title: Dually Constrained Parameter Projection for Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.29269v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continual learning requires a model to learn multiple new tasks sequentially while retaining performance on previous tasks. Projecting model parameters onto the Jacobian null space of previous tasks after unconstrained training on a new task has emerged as an effective paradigm. However, unidirectional projection merely minimizes the parameter distance to the new-task optimum, overlooking the new-task loss landscape. To address this limitation, we propose DUET, a bidirectional projection algorithm that imposes Jacobian null-space constraints from both previous and new tasks during post-training projection. Specifically, DUET formulates the post-training adjustment as a dually constrained optimization problem. It minimizes the distance between parameters before and after training on a new task, subject to loss preserving constraints on both tasks. To solve the optimization problem, we develop an alternating bidirectional projection algo

translated_title: 持续学习中的双重约束参数投影
translated_abstract: 持续学习要求模型在顺序学习多个新任务的同时，保持对先前任务的性能。在新任务上进行无约束训练后，将模型参数投影到先前任务的雅可比零空间上，已成为一种有效的范式。然而，单向投影仅仅最小化参数与新任务最优解之间的距离，而忽略了新任务的损失景观。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了DUET，一种双向投影算法，它在训练后投影过程中同时施加来自先前任务和新任务的雅可比零空间约束。具体而言，DUET将训练后调整表述为一个双重约束优化问题：它最小化新任务训练前后参数之间的距离，同时满足对两个任务的损失保持约束。为了求解该优化问题，我们开发了一种交替双向投影算法……
tldr: 提出DUET算法，将持续学习中的训练后参数调整形式化为双重约束优化问题，通过同时施加新旧任务的雅可比零空间约束进行双向投影，更好地兼顾新任务学习与旧任务记忆。
en_tdlr: Proposes DUET, a bidirectional projection algorithm that formulates post-training parameter adjustment as a dually constrained optimization problem, imposing Jacobian null-space constraints from both previous and new tasks to balance new-task learning and old-task retention in continual learning.
